description: This script manages telemetry data upload, including handling retries, different connection methods (Direct and Codebig), and queuing failed uploads. It interacts with system properties, external configuration files, and network utilities to perform telemetry uploads via HTTP or TFTP, with logic for scheduling and error handling.

methods.name: getTelemetryEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the telemetry upload URL from RFC or response file, sets DCA_UPLOAD_URL.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Checks for Codebig availability and configures connection preferences.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Performs telemetry upload via direct HTTP or TFTP, with retries and fallback logic.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Performs telemetry upload via Codebig, with security signing and retries.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Fetches the IPv4 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Fetches the IPv6 address of the erouter interface.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file to prevent duplicate script instances.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Determines if direct connection is temporarily blocked (currently always returns false).
